_note: Camp life (D-034): the food and cooking each game actually has. 'cartridge' = the game has it; 'believed' = remembered, still to check against the game. Which of these a team uses is authored per team, because it depends on the team. Items are checked against PokeAPI by the engine.

systems.what: Fixed berry trees along routes; each gives a berry once a day.

Apricorn trees, one Apricorn a day. Kurt in Azalea Town turns them into Poké Balls: Red into Level Ball, Blue into Lure Ball, Yellow into Moon Ball, Green into Friend Ball, Pink into Love Ball, White into Fast Ball, Black into Heavy Ball.
Apricorns blended into Aprijuice at the Pokéathlon Dome; it changes a Pokémon's Pokéathlon performance.
Bottled milk that restores HP. Johto's comes from the MooMoo Farm on Route 39, where a sick Miltank needs berries.
A Shuckle holding a berry can turn it into Berry Juice (Cianwood's Shuckle). Whether later games keep the trick: verify.
Plant berries in soft soil, water them, and harvest several of the same berry days later. Platinum adds mulch to change growth speed.
Berries blended into Pokéblocks with the Berry Blender in Lilycove; fed to raise contest condition (and to bring out Feebas's beauty for Milotic).
Berries cooked into Poffins at the Poffin House in Hearthome City; fed to raise contest condition. The closest thing the games have to cooking.
Honey slathered on sweet-scented trees draws out wild Pokémon; Combee with Honey Gather collect it.
Mahogany Town's specialty; heals every status problem.
Lavaridge Town's specialty, sold at the foot of Mt. Chimney; heals every status problem.
Sinnoh's old-fashioned cake; heals every status problem (where Platinum hands it out: verify).
Fresh Water, Soda Pop and Lemonade from vending machines (Celadon rooftop and elsewhere).
